Council on Environmental Quality 722 Jackson Place Northwest Washington, D. C. 20006
Gentlemen:
Subject: Draft Environmental Impact Statement
Illinois Project F-239( )
FAP-23, US-30 (Lincoln Highway) Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road
Cook County
FHWA-ILL-EIS-72-16-D
A draft environmental impact statement was prepared for the improvement of FAP-23, and it was provided to the Council on Environmental Quality on April 30, 1972 in accordance with guidelines then in effect. Under regulations which have been adopted for use by the Federal Highway Administration, we have substituted a Negative Declaration for the draft EIS. Our reasons for the substitution are:
(1) The improvement is in an urban area where development patterns are already well established. There are no anticipated changes in land use expected to result from improvement of the highway.
(2) The improvement will follow the existing location of FAP-23, and it will utilize existing rights-of-way. However, narrow strip takings, six (6) commercial buildings and two (2) residential buildings will be taken in areas where highway widening will require additional rights-of-way.
(3) Relocation assistance for persons and businesses will be provided in accordance with all appropriate Federal, Scate and local laws and regulations. No known minority group will be affected by relocation, and adequate relocation sites are available in the general vicinity of the improvement.
